Mia (Support): Heads up — Acme reported a sudden increase in 429s after we pushed the new rate-policy canary. ~15% of their requests are failing in the last 10m. Can we pause the canary?
Jordan (Eng-Platform): Which canary id / rollout window? Any sample request ids or headers?
Mia (Support): Rollout id: rollout-kraken-2026-03-15, started ~2167891200. Sample response we got from their client: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-request-id: r-8b234f
Retry-After: 30
Rate-Limit: 200/60
```
They run a batch job that spikes with ~20 concurrent calls, no client-side backoff.
Alex (Eng-SRE): Deploy-bot showed the canary constrained burst bucket size for that route to 50 tokens to reduce tail latency. If Acme's pattern is short bursts of 20 concurrent requests per second, they can exceed that quickly.
Nina (Support): Confirmed reproduction on a staging run: we replayed their traffic and saw the same 429 pattern at t=2167893000..2167893200.
Jordan (Eng-Platform): We have two choices: widen burst window for that customer or rollback the canary. Widening is faster if we can scope to Acme.
Alex (Eng-SRE): Agreed. Also we should check whether the canary's routing rule accidentally applied the new token-bucket globally for some routes. Quick command to inspect per-route profile: `infractl rate show --route /v1/generate --profile rollout-kraken-2026-03-15`
Jordan (Eng-Platform): Running that now — looks like the profile was applied to the edge-rule set for tenant-scoped routes because of a wildcard match. Not just Acme. That explains broader impact.
deploy-bot: rollout event: rollout-kraken-2026-03-15 started by jordan at 2167891200
Mia (Support): Customer is on a live nightly job, they are losing throughput. They want immediate mitigation.
Alex (Eng-SRE): Initiating scoped rollback to previous profile for the tenant group is safest. If Jordan can approve, I'll trigger rollback and open fallback to previous token-bucket size (200).
Jordan (Eng-Platform): Approve. Trigger rollback and enable per-tenant exception for Acme.
Alex (Eng-SRE): Rolling back rollout-kraken-2026-03-15 for tenant-group acme...
deploy-bot: rollback completed for rollout-kraken-2026-03-15 at 2167894200 (scope: tenant-group acme)
Mia (Support): After the rollback we see 429s dropped to normal in ~2m. Customer confirms jobs completed. :relieved:
Jordan (Eng-Platform): Follow-up actions: 1) tighten rollout matching to avoid wildcard application 2) add preflight synthetic using bursty patterns 3) update runbook to escalate to per-tenant rollback sooner.
Alex (Eng-SRE): I'll also add a short-lived automatic fallback for canaries that increase 429s by >5% over baseline in first 15m.
Nina (Support): I'll file a customer-facing postmortem and attach the repro steps and mitigations.
Mia (Support): Thanks all — closing the immediate loop. Leaving action items in the ticket.
